svg.text: Gemini selects from these on each iteration
Head-to-head splits: player performance vs. opponent
Filter stats by home/away, W/L, clutch, date range
Top-N league leaders for any stat & season
User types query → browser sends POST /api/query to Flask, receives job_id
Flask spawns a background NBAStatsAgent thread; browser opens SSE connection
Agent calls Gemini 2.5 Flash → LLM reasons and selects which NBA tools to call
Tools execute: career stats, game logs, awards, H2H splits via stats.nba.com
bbref_client provides fallback for 2025-26 season data and current leaderboards
Agent merges data via _merge_raw_logs(), Gemini generates final narrative
Flask streams SSE events → browser renders career cards, highs, accolades & charts
User reads natural language response; can ask follow-up queries to restart the loop
